column1: # Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Larian's Divinity Engine on SDK 9.3.0, update 1.0.12 (v786432); 12,329 shaders in the bundle (12,256 from the LSPK packages' .bshd members, 73 from main).
# Tested 2026-11-20 on the Legion Y700 Gen 4 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, the system Vulkan driver): boot, the title, a new game (Classic), character creation,
# the intro movie, the prison ship (hold and Merryweather decks), its combat and Fort Joy's beach, driven with DM_CTL and played by hand (about 50 minutes);
# the game menu, a manual and a quick save, Continue / Load after a relaunch (saves dated right since the network clock fix), the port's pause menu.
# 60 fps (game.tsv present_interval): GPU 8-14 ms a frame on the ship, frames on screen every 16.7 ms with 0-3 of 300 dropped. In the heaviest scenes (fights, the
# beach) the GPU takes 16-18 ms a frame and about 10% of frames are dropped there (1.3% over the whole session); the game's dynamic resolution never lowers
# the 1600x900 scene, as it reads 0 GPU time. No crash in about 100 minutes over three sessions; memory 1.3-1.5 GB in play, flat over a 15-minute soak; no audio underruns.
# Open: "[alias] stale read" lines (a 1440x810 target sampled after a 1600x900 one was drawn into its memory), with nothing wrong seen on screen; the inventory /
# character sheet radial (hold R) did not open with DM_CTL presses.
